scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && IMPORT_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT=1 tsx scripts/seed-or-import.ts && tsx scripts/fix-offday-workdates.ts && tsx scripts/fix-contract-start-dates.ts --apply && tsx scripts/new-contract-prep-week.ts --all --repair-only --apply && next build

scripts.db:clean-orphans:prod: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx scripts/clean-orphan-writes.ts && prisma generate
scripts.db:fix-june-credit:prod: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx scripts/fix-june-photographer-credit.ts && prisma generate
scripts.db:fix-timestamps:prod: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx scripts/fix-historical-timestamps.ts && prisma generate
scripts.db:backfill-cycles:prod: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx scripts/backfill-contract-cycles.ts && prisma generate
scripts.db:backfill-numbers:prod: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx scripts/backfill-piece-numbers.ts && prisma generate
scripts.setup: npm install && prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
